title: Do Language Models Understand Honorific Systems in Javanese?
reasoning: The paper focuses on Javanese honorifics (Unggah-Ungguh Basa), which is a system of linguistic etiquette and social hierarchy. While it evaluates the 'cultural appropriateness' of model outputs and identifies performance biases toward specific linguistic registers, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
